title: The seasonal decline in housing inventory is in full force
summary: Inventory fell to 895,988, down 6,752 week to week, while new listings were 53,162 vs 56,569 last year.

title: Could Budapest be the next digital nomad hotspot?
summary: With its mix of sights, cafés and culture, Hungary's capital Budapest has become popular with those embracing the "work from anywhere" trend.

title: Rising rents draw Wall Street money to industrial outdoor storage lot investments across the U.S.
summary: A real estate investment in markets across the U.S. called 'industrial outdoor storage' is attracting Wall Street giants including Brookfield and Blackstone.
